newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures close lower across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures close lower across the board.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended the first trading day of the year lower on Monday, reflecting losses in the Chicago market during the New Year holidays, traders said.
Prices were 90 to 220 yen lower, with the benchmark January 1998 contract down 90 yen at 14,270 yen per tonne.
Light selling from local investors pushed down all months from the open, traders said. The Chicago market's price falls during the holidays added to the bearishness, they said.
"The yen's weakness against the dollar limited the selling," a trader said. Investors are watching the USDA's crop reports, which will be released on January 10.
The spot March corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.57 per bushel at 0600 GMT, against $2.56-1/2 at Friday's close.
The spot January of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $6.93-1/4 at 0600 GMT, against $6.96-1/4 previously.
